text: Harness self-improvement: agent proposes harness config changes, kept only if a benchmark subset improves
description: Research cycle 2026-11-08 (harness evolution as self-improvement without weight updates: Recuris arXiv 2608.24876, Hierarchical Self-Improvement arXiv 2608.08466, Recursive self-improvement of AI research agents arXiv 2609.26457). Loop: read failed/unverifiable traces -> attribute the failure to one harness component (context section, stage prompt, budget, decomposition limit) -> propose one bounded change to the versioned harness config -> rerun a frozen benchmark subset -> keep if better and no regression, else revert. Every kept change is a commit with before/after numbers. Builds on 13d74766 (three bounded cycles, done on evaluator code) but targets the harness itself.

status.comment: Proposed by Claude from the 2026-11-08 research cycle. Needs harness config file, traces and a benchmark subset first.
